attack: exact transformed sequences vs raw c

kill.text: Killed. No transform is simpler than raw c in all three of linear complexity, periodicity witnesses, and discrepancy. Every screened transform still has L(N) ≥ N/4 at N=4096 and N=16384; none has a tiny last-mismatch for a small period on the scanned prefix; signed sums stay the same order as D(N). A single nicer statistic is not a prize claim. Not a prize claim.
